```python
import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Job data
jobs = {
    0: {"processing_time": 82, "due_date": 828, "weight": 4},
    1: {"processing_time": 58, "due_date": 503, "weight": 10},
    2: {"processing_time": 32, "due_date": 228, "weight": 5},
    3: {"processing_time": 44, "due_date": 316, "weight": 5},
    4: {"processing_time": 13, "due_date": 224, "weight": 9},
    5: {"processing_time": 68, "due_date": 865, "weight": 3},
    6: {"processing_time": 95, "due_date": 491, "weight": 2},
    7: {"processing_time": 89, "due_date": 456, "weight": 8},
    8: {"processing_time": 16, "due_date": 946, "weight": 5},
    9: {"processing_time": 11, "due_date": 679, "weight": 4},
    10: {"processing_time": 43, "due_date": 763, "weight": 4},
    11: {"processing_time": 10, "due_date": 624, "weight": 1},
    12: {"processing_time": 19, "due_date": 810, "weight": 8},
    13: {"processing_time": 80, "due_date": 665, "weight": 4},
    14: {"processing_time": 99, "due_date": 525, "weight": 5},
    15: {"processing_time": 96, "due_date": 526, "weight": 2},
    16: {"processing_time": 96, "due_date": 976, "weight": 6},
    17: {"processing_time": 92, "due_date": 167, "weight": 7},
    18: {"processing_time": 12, "due_date": 790, "weight": 5},
    19: {"processing_time": 83, "due_date": 910, "weight": 4},
    20: {"processing_time": 68, "due_date": 933, "weight": 8},
    21: {"processing_time": 39, "due_date": 297, "weight": 5},
    22: {"processing_time": 86, "due_date": 700, "weight": 2},
    23: {"processing_time": 71, "due_date": 616, "weight": 6},
    24: {"processing_time": 44, "due_date": 634, "weight": 1},
}

# Create a new model
model = gp.Model("single_machine_scheduling")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Create variables
n = len(jobs)
x = model.addVars(n, n, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="x")
C = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="C")
T = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name="T")

# Set objective
model.setObjective(gp.quicksum(jobs[j]["weight"] * T[j] for j in range(n)), GRB.MINIMIZE)

# Add constraints
model.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for j in range(n)) == 1 for i in range(n)), name="assign_once")
model.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[j, i] for j in range(n)) == 1 for i in range(n)), name="assigned_once")

model.addConstrs((C[j] >= jobs[j]["processing_time"] + gp.quicksum(jobs[i]["processing_time"] * x[i, j] for i in range(n)) for j in range(n)), name="completion_time")

model.addConstrs((T[j] >= C[j] - jobs[j]["due_date"] for j in range(n)), name="tardiness")

# Optimize model
model.optimize()

# Extract the sequence
sequence = [j for j in range(n) for i in range(n) if x[i, j].X > 0.5]

# Calculate the objective value
objective_value = model.ObjVal

# Output the result
import json
result = {"sequence": sequence, "objective_value": objective_value}
print(json.dumps(result))
```
